name: Option Plans Summary
description: 以 Gyre Option Plans Summary SL workbook 为标准输入，校验核心列后过滤空计划行，并计算每行 value。

tasks.name: Extract Option Plans Summary

fileRef.$label: Gyre Option Plans Summary SL workbook

tasks.description: 从 Gyre Option Plans Summary SL workbook 读取汇总表，表头位于第 2 行，数据从 A3 开始，宽度读取到实际使用列。

tasks.name: Assert Option Plans Summary Schema

params.failureMessage: Assert Option Plans Summary Schema failed
params.expectedColumns: Plan Name, Outstanding Calc., Options Outstanding, Available Shares in Pool, Category for Grouping, Sorting

tasks.description: 校验 Option Plans Summary 输入是否包含计算 value 所需的核心列。

tasks.name: Filter Option Plans Summary meaningless rows

params.sql:
select
  [Category for Grouping] as category_for_grouping,
  [Sorting] as sorting,
  [Plan Name] as [key],
  case
    when coalesce([Outstanding Calc.], 0) <> 0 then [Outstanding Calc.]
    when coalesce([Options Outstanding], 0) <> 0 then [Options Outstanding]
    when coalesce([Available Shares in Pool], 0) <> 0 then [Available Shares in Pool]
    else 0
  end as [value]
from {option_plans_summary}
where trim(concat('', coalesce([Plan Name], ''))) <> ''
  and trim(concat('', coalesce([Category for Grouping], ''))) <> ''
  and trim(concat('', coalesce([Category for Grouping], ''))) <> '0011PLAN_2018 ESPP (Manual Reserve)'

tasks.description: 过滤空 Plan Name 行，并按 Outstanding Calc.、Options Outstanding、Available Shares in Pool 的优先级取第一个非 0 非空数字为 value。

tasks.name: Transform Option Plans Summary

params.sql:
select
  base.category_for_grouping,
  (
    select lookup.[key]
    from {option_plans_summary_values} as lookup
    where lookup.category_for_grouping = base.category_for_grouping
      and coalesce(lookup.sorting, 999999999) <= coalesce(base.sorting, 999999999)
      and lookup.[key] not in (
        'Granted',
        'Exercised',
        'Repurchased',
        'Cancelled',
        'Awards Outstanding',
        'Shares Remaining For Issuance',
        'Awards Outstanding + Shares Remaining for Issuance'
      )
      and trim(concat('', coalesce(lookup.[key], ''))) <> ''
    order by coalesce(lookup.sorting, 999999999) desc, lookup.[key] desc
    limit 1
  ) as plan_name,
  base.[key],
  base.[value]
from {option_plans_summary_values} as base
where [key] in (
    'Granted',
    'Exercised',
    'Repurchased',
    'Cancelled',
    'Awards Outstanding',
    'Shares Remaining For Issuance',
    'Awards Outstanding + Shares Remaining for Issuance'
  )
order by category_for_grouping, sorting, [key]

tasks.description: 按 Category for Grouping 和 Sorting 顺序，将每条指标归属到其前面最近的实际计划名称；同一分类下存在多个计划时分别保留，避免把多个计划合并。
